name: Tally
author: jmad
description: A record dot that lights the moment OBS goes live, and a desk that puts its notifications, clipboard and history away until it ends

barWidget.description: A record dot that dims while OBS is closed, sits plain while it is open, and lights up while the stream is live

schema.label: Poll interval (ms)
schema.description: How often OBS is asked what it is doing.

schema.label: Silence notifications while live
schema.description: Turn do not disturb on for the length of the stream, and leave it as it was found.

schema.label: Hold the screen awake while live
schema.description: Keep the idle lock and the screensaver off for the length of the stream.

schema.label: Say when the stream starts and ends
schema.description: A notification as the stream goes live, and another as it ends.

schema.label: Open links in
schema.description: A desktop entry, such as chromium.desktop, that links go to while the stream is live. Empty leaves them where they already go.

schema.label: Empty the clipboard history while live
schema.description: Put the clipboard history away for the length of the stream, and fetch it back at the end. What was copied during the stream goes with it.

schema.label: Empty the recent files while live
schema.description: Put the recent files every file dialog offers away for the length of the stream.

schema.label: Empty the notification centre while live
schema.description: Put the notifications already waiting to be read away for the length of the stream. Do not disturb only stops the next one.

schema.label: Empty the shell history while live
schema.description: Ctrl-R and autosuggestion answer with nothing for the length of the stream, and what is typed during it is forgotten. Needs shell/tally-history.sh sourced from your shell.
